warning.titlePre: Mercedes SLS AMG GT Timing Chain & Valve Train Wear
paragraphs: If your SLS AMG GT has the M159 6.2-litre naturally aspirated V8 - the only engine fitted to every SLS AMG GT - timing chain wear, valve train issues and head gasket wear at higher mileage are well-documented patterns on this engine. We replace timing chains, valve train components, head gaskets and bearings as standard on every M159 rebuild.
